mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals broad demand contraction, prompting equity market flight to quality and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress equity multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risks, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals potential economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration that triggers central bank stimulus expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
